name: top_customers_by_revenue
question: who are our top 10 customers by revenue?
reference_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.qty * oi.price) AS revenue
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
reading: Ten customers that still exist, ranked by what they actually paid. Name and revenue only: an id column would join the sort key and demand a tiebreak the question never asked for.
